speaker: PALLAS NEGAN
description: PALLAS NEGAN should sound like: Middle-aged to older male; Authoritative, aristocratic timbre; Thoughtful and refined delivery; Heavy; Boastful; Aristocratic; Calculated; Politically minding; Cynical towards other nobles; Indulgent.
ref_text: Invite Earl Hall to be my guest tomorrow. I would like to discuss with him about increasing the remuneration of the factory workers and improving their working hours, as well as amending the Poor Law.
